# Ratatouille

Summer vegetables slowly stewed in olive oil: aubergine, courgette, peppers, tomatoes and onion, each cooked separately before they meet in the pot. Cutting everything to a similar size makes the texture even. Start with the aubergine, salted and drained, then fry the courgettes until golden.

Combine with garlic, thyme and a bay leaf and simmer uncovered for forty minutes. It tastes better the next day, cold or reheated, with a drizzle of fresh olive oil. Serve with grilled fish, rice or a poached egg. The recipe doubles easily and freezes well in portions.
